rationale: Dangerous: connects to the realtime relay under a different app id in index.html <inline script>:29.

findings.title: Connects to the realtime relay under a different app id
findings.detail: Connects to the Brewser realtime relay as app "ws-test", but this package is "com.natureglass.websocketsdemo". Joining another package's rooms grants read/write of its messages and shared state.

findings.title: Network request to an off-package external origin
findings.detail: new WebSocket() targets wss://ws.brewser.io?app=ws-test&room=lobby, an origin not in the manifest allowed_origins.

limitations: Static heuristic scan. A GOOD verdict means no known-bad pattern matched, NOT proof of safety. Human review is still required for every submission.
